incident-bot: Paging: PROD SLO breach detected for /v1/chat-generation. p99=3.2s, p95=1.1s. Canary pool 'v3-b' traffic increased at 09:12 local -> correlated with spike. Severity: HIGH. Link: https://dash.redwood.example/incidents/1859876543
Maya (oncall): I'm on it. Observing dashboards now. @Priya can you check canary nodes and runtime logs?
Priya (sre): Looking. p95 ~1.1s, p99 ~3.2s. Streaming stalls showing long tail during KV cache flushes. Traffic shift from 10%->60% at 09:12 appears to coincide.
Eric (runtime): Noted. v3-b uses q4f16 kernels and new attention kernels. Under small batch sizes decode time jumps. Kernel selection looks off for current seq len distribution.
Sam (product): We started the gradual shift at 09:12 per rollout plan. Did we change batching or routing config? @Logan any infra changes?
Logan (infra): No config changes besides traffic weight. Autoscaler spiked at 09:10 but cooldown prevented enough warm instances. Some GPU hosts hit 100% and queues built up.
Maya (oncall): Taylor (CS), any customer reports coming in?
Taylor (cs): Yep — two enterprise customers filed timeouts in the last 30m. I'm escalating and drafting an interim update.
Priya (sre): Mitigation options:
  1) throttle canary to 5% (fast)
  2) full rollback to v2 (immediate)
  3) enable model fallback for streaming requests to v2 while we debug
Which do we prefer? :thinking_face: 
Maya (oncall): Throttle to 5% now and monitor for 5m. If no quick improvement, initiate full rollback. Priya — please apply throttling.
Priya (sre): Applying traffic policy now.

```
# rolloutctl patch service/redwood-chat --set-weight v3-b=5%
# txn: apply-0x83a
```

deploy-bot: Rollout controller: route weight update applied for service redwood-chat: v3-b=5%, v2=95% (txn 0x83a)
Maya (oncall): Watching metrics after change...
Priya (sre): p99 dropped to 1.4s within ~90s after throttling. p95 back to ~400ms. Streaming stalls much reduced but a small fraction of sessions still see hangs.
Eric (runtime): I can see KV cache thrash and fallback to older kernels on some hosts. I'll push a runtime toggle to prefer q8-compatible kernels for canary pool until we verify q4f16 path.
Logan (infra): Provisioning 4 extra GPU nodes to absorb tail load and reduce queueing. Warmup scripts deployed.
Taylor (cs): Sent interim customer message: "We're throttling the new model rollout and routing traffic to the stable model while we investigate. No data loss expected. ETA 30m for status update." :email: 
Priya (sre): Throttle helped but root cause looks like kernel selection + autoscaler cooldown. Recommend full rollback to avoid further customer impact.
Sam (product): Agree — prioritize SLOs. Priya, please perform rollback when ready.
Priya (sre): Initiating rollback.

```
# releasectl rollback redwood-chat --from v3-b --to v2 --reason "SLO breach after traffic shift"
# txn: rollback-0x83b
```

deploy-bot: Release rollback initiated: rolling v2 back to primary. v3-b weight 5% -> 0% in progress (txn 0x83b). Estimated completion ~2m.
Maya (oncall): Oncall handoff: @Logan you'll own infra scaling & node health until stabilized. I'll stay on the thread for postmortem. Priya assign INC ticket and collect artifacts.
Priya (sre): Created INC-2026 with timeline, logs, kernel traces attached. Assigning to runtime+infra+product. https://tracker.redwood.example/INC-2026
Eric (runtime): Collected kernel traces + heap profiles. Uploaded to shared: https://files.redwood.example/1859876543/traces
Priya (sre): Post-rollback metrics: p99=210ms, p95=90ms. All clear from alerting side. Clearing paging alert in 10m if stable.
Taylor (cs): Customer update sent: "Rollback complete, monitoring. We'll send RCA when available." :thumbsup: 
Maya (oncall): Thanks team. Action items (INC-2026):
 - Eric: validate kernel selection logic and add canary-specific fallback
 - Logan: review autoscaler cooldown thresholds and warm pool sizing
 - Sam: update rollout playbook to include immediate throttle step for large model binaries
 - Priya: own RCA and attach perf traces
Priya (sre): Assignments noted. I'll also add post-incident verification checklist and schedule replay tests for v3-b with tuned kernels.
Sam (product): We'll also run a synthetic load test that matches streaming session distribution before next rollout.
deploy-bot: Incident monitoring: SLO alert cleared for /v1/chat-generation. Incident state -> mitigated.
Maya (oncall): Closing thread after postmortem created. Great work everyone. :clap:
